description: Equipo de tercero del Colegio North School que nos gusta crear videojuegos
summary: Our challenge design uses a video game format to show what happens when a spacecraft encounters asteroids during a journey—specifically, how they can damage the craft.
details: In the video game created in the Scratch programming environment, a spaceship must dodge asteroids; it starts with 10 lives, and if an asteroid hits the ship, a life is lost—when the number of lives reaches zero, the game ends.
